headline: O'Hare departures are lagging; the other hubs are running normally.

items.text: Chicago O'Hare is the lowest of the seven United hubs reporting, with 79% of departures so far today leaving within 30 minutes of schedule (460 departed).
The other hubs are running normally, with departures on time.

No FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at any United hub. A ground delay program is in effect for flights into Seattle until 9:59 PM PT; those flights are held at their departure airport, with delays averaging 32 minutes, up to 82 minutes.

Neither is in effect: the FAA's operations plan says a ground stop or ground delay program is possible for flights into Newark tomorrow after 10:00 AM ET, and for flights into San Francisco tomorrow after 7:00 AM PT.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Seattle, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
